interpretation_warning: Registration counts do not establish whether an enterprise is active, profitable or currently employing staff.

kpi_definitions.average_registrations_per_district: Gujarat registration total divided by the number of districts in the source dataset.
kpi_definitions.category_share_pct: Category registration count divided by the Gujarat registration total, multiplied by 100.
kpi_definitions.total_registered_enterprises: Sum of Micro, Small and Medium UDYAM registration counts across Gujarat districts.
